title: Delegate task-local L3 design and implementation to two worktrees
decision: Two team members may author their own task-local L3 contracts and implement directly in separate worktrees. The project owner owns frozen L1/L2 decisions, shared integration points, merge order, and final acceptance; L3 approval occurs at worktree handoff/integration rather than before local implementation starts.
constraints: Each worktree has exclusive write ownership over assigned paths.
No member edits the other worktree's owned paths or shared integration paths.
Shared contract changes are additive in task-owned files; application.py and canonical contract exports are project-owner-owned.
Every worktree must include its L3 contract, acceptance tests, rollback note and evidence in its handoff.
A worktree may not silently change UD-006 semantics; deviations require a decision-board entry and owner notification.
merge_order: Worktree A foundation first; Worktree B rebases onto the merged foundation; project owner integrates both into the main line and runs end-to-end acceptance.
reversal_condition: Repeated merge conflicts, incompatible contract changes, or inability to produce isolated acceptance evidence requires returning to centrally frozen L3 boundaries.
